question.text: If the order of the differential equation of the family of circles touching the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math>-axis at the origin is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>k</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
The equation of the family is x2+y-r2=r2
i.e. only one arbitrary constant.
Hence, the order of its differential equation will be '1'
∴2k=2
